name: Tidy Bakery
storyline:
Your grandpa has gone away on vacation and left you in charge of his bakery and his old cat. There’s just one little problem… the bakery was a complete mess when you arrived!

Luckily, Grandpa’s vacation is quite long. Plenty of time to put everything back where it belongs!
summary: Tidy Bakery is a cozy, relaxing first-person sorting and organizing game where your bakery is a little… messy! 🥐 Pick up, sort, and put away over 3,000 delicious pastries, from donuts and croissants to cupcakes and cakes. Unlock helpful upgrades, enjoy satisfying ASMR sounds, and watch out for a mischievous cat who might make another mess! Take your time, unwind, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order. ✨
